user_stories.title: 6.1 Approve Compensation
user_stories.verifiable:
System shall generate and trigger an email to Approving Officer(Asset) to notify him/her there is a compensation case pending approval. If the case is not approved, an email shall be sent to Approving Officer(Asset) every 7-day interval to remind him/her of the outstanding cases.
Approving Officer(Asset) shall be allowed to verify various types of payment, i.e. Use, Loss, Damage, Appeal for Use, Appeal for Loss, and Appeal for Damage.
For Asset Requisition Plan, Approving Officer(Asset) shall be able to:
6.1.4.1 6.1.5 6.1.6 6.1.7 a. View Requisition Plan including the Requisition and De-requisition Forms. b. View Progressive compensation details. c. View compensation details, e.g. usage duration, unit rate, compensation amount, GST status, Earmarked CR category, Report CR category. d. Update the fund objects (e.g. G/L account, Commitment Item, Funds Centre, Cost Centre, etc). This is applicable only for MINDEF/SAF. e. Approve single/multiple compensation cases. f. Reject single/multiple compensation cases and state the reason(s) for the rejection. For Asset Modification/Inspection, Approving Officer(Asset) shall be able to a. Approve compensation requests. b. Reject compensation requests and state the reason(s) for the rejection. Approving Officer(Asset) shall be able to generate a. Asset Requisition Compensation Report. This report shall generate requisition compensation for CR assets with requisition plan. b. Asset Requisition Compensation Report (MINDEF/SAF). This report shall generate compensation for CR assets with requisition plan, with additional information, i.e. consists of MINDEF/SAF payments details that go through Payment Service Hub/ Enterprise System for payment. c. Asset Modification/Inspection Compensation Report. This report shall generate compensation for CR assets without requisition plan, namely modification and inspection compensation. d. Asset Modification/Inspection Payment Report (MINDEF/SAF). This report shall generate payment information for CR assets without requisition plan, namely modification and inspection compensation with additional information, i.e. consists of MINDEF/SAF payments details that go through Payment Service Hub/ Enterprise System for payment. For MINDEF/SAF related ReqCens, system shall ensure that the fund objects shall be maintained in a mapping table and shall be ReqCen specific. The fund objects shall be included in the compensation cases automatically. Approving Officer(Asset) shall be allowed to amend the fund objects. This is applicable only for MINDEF/SAF. Approving Officer(Asset) shall be able to export/download the reports. Approving Officer(Asset) shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field. 7 REQUESTOR(ASSET_WOG) USER STORY

user_stories.title: 7.1 Manage Asset Requirements
user_stories.verifiable: Requestor(Asset_WOG) shall be able to create, update, view, verify, reject and delete CR asset requirements for the EGBs he/she is authorised. Requirements shall be submitted at EGB level (select from drop down list). Requirements shall be based on CR Type & CR Category (select from drop down list), CR category (select from drop down list), and quantities in whole number. a. For EGB’s requirements, REQUESTOR(Asset_WOG) shall select its EGB. b. For Essential Companies’ requirements, Requestor(Asset_WOG) shall select from the list of Essential Companies registered by the EGB. System shall have a field to select the approving authority (select from drop down list). System shall have a free text field to enter internal remarks, e.g. approval reference and approval date. Requestor(Asset_WOG) shall be able to view the current and rejected CR requirements. System shall have a function to download a template containing all the essential fields that shall be populated to support mass load into CRIPS. System shall have a function to upload a filled template containing all the information needed to mass upload the CR asset requirements into CRIPS. Requestor(Asset_WOG) shall be able to view the allocation by CR category, including substitution CR category and the corresponding quantity allocation. System shall have a mapping table to assign the SCDF ReqCens to the WOG agencies. Requestor(Asset) managing SCDF ReqCens shall be able to maintain this mapping table, e.g. via Assign EE to ReqCen module. Requestor(Asset_WOG) shall be able to export/download the information. Requestor(Asset_WOG) shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

user_stories.title: 7.2 Manage Asset Exemption
user_stories.verifiable:
Requestor(Asset_WOG) shall be able to create, update, view and delete CR asset exemption request.
Asset exemption requests shall be routed to the respective Controller for approval. Controller can approve or reject the request. Requestor (Asset_WOG) shall be able to create requests to un-exempt assets that the Controllers have approved earlier. Such requests shall be routed to the respective Controller for approval. He/She shall be able to update, view and delete such requests. System shall ensure that exempted assets cannot be allocated nor requisitioned. When EMA_AO or EMA_EO attempt to requisition an exempted asset, system shall prompt appropriate message to inform him/her the asset is exempted from requisition. Requestor(Asset_WOG) shall be able to export/download the information. Requestor(Asset_WOG) shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field. b. 8 CRO(UNDERTAKING) USER STORY

user_stories.title: 8.1 Manage Undertaking Requirements
user_stories.verifiable:
System shall list Controller Undertakings as one of the Lead Agencies for selection under the Lead Agency field.
System shall display the agency’s Undertaking requirements. There shall be a quick filter function to allow CRO(Undertaking) to choose the status, a. ‘All’ – This shall be the default selection, and display all Undertaking requirements regardless of their status. ‘Re-submit Requirement’ – Display all Undertaking requirements with the ‘Review Requirement’ status, i.e. requirements rejected from Lead Agency due to various reasons (e.g. incomplete information). CRO(Undertaking) shall be allow to re-submit their requirements upon completing the follow-up actions (e.g. include missing information in the earlier submission). ‘Submit Company Details’ – Display all requirements that are pending the agency’s action to fill in the allocated company details for submission of security clearance (template per MHA’s requirements). At the end of the relevant tabs, system shall show the number of pending requirements in amber to denote there are requirements that need CRO(Undertaking)’s action. No number shall be displayed when there is no pending requirement.
In displaying the Undertakings requirements, system shall show the following information a. Agency’s Reference Number b. Requesting Agency c. d. C-91 c. Lead Agency d. ACRA file) e. Services Required f. Status Allocated Company (show UEN and latest Company Name retrieved from g. Last Updated h. Last Updated by When CRO(Undertaking) sets quick filter to ‘All’, system shall provide a progress bar to show the status, e.g. ‘Re-submit Requirement’, ‘Submit Company Details’. ‘Status’ shall have an ‘info’ button. When CRO(Undertaking) mouse over the button, the system shall display the status tooltip. CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to create new undertaking requirements and he/she shall fill in the following information (mandatory for all unless specify otherwise), a. Reference Number (fill in the agency internal reference number) b. Requesting Agency (select from the dropdown list) c. Approver Name (fill in the agency’s approver name) d. Approver Title (select from the dropdown list) e. Approval Date (fill in the date that agency’s obtained the approval to register this undertaking requirement or company) f. h. Lead Agency (select from the dropdown list) g. Services Required Preferred Company (optional - select from the dropdown list with search function using UEN or partial company name; SSIC of the company shall be auto-populated when a UEN is selected) CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to save the inputs as draft. He/She shall be able to retrieve the draft and continue to update it for final submission. Upon clicking on ‘Submit’ for new undertaking requirements, a. If the preferred company is already an approved company/firm, system shall inform CRO(Undertaking) and state the company/firm is supporting the number of WOG agencies and inform that there are other companies with the same SSIC that might be suitable. System shall require CRO(Undertaking) to acknowledge the following before he/she could proceed to confirm the submission: b.  I am aware that [UEN] [Name of Company] selected in this submission will be a shared EF upon final approval of my registration request.  My agency will work with the shared EF to develop an E-Plan. Once clicking on ‘Confirm’, system shall route the request to the selected Lead Agency for allocation. An email notification shall be sent to the relevant Lead Agency or Controller Undertakings to inform of a request pending his/her action. c. There shall be audit trail to record the acknowledgement and timestamp. CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to modify, view and delete undertaking requirements submitted by his/her agency. Only requirements with process prior to Allocation can be modified or deleted while the rest are for view only. An email notification shall be sent to the relevant Lead Agency to inform of a request has been modified/deleted. System shall send an email notification to the CRO(Undertaking) to inform him/her when a request is rejected by Lead Agency. He/She shall be able to view the case and the reasons for rejection. He/She shall be able to update/rectify the rejected requirements and re-submit it to the Lead Agency, including selecting another Lead Agency. An email notification shall be sent to the relevant Lead Agency users to inform of a request pending his/her action. For shared firms, at the allocation/approval stage, the Lead Agency/Controller Undertakings shall be able to assign a co-ordinating agency who will co- ordinate/oversee a combined E-Plan. The co-ordinating agency is an optional field. For allocated undertaking requirements, CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to enter the company details for submission of security clearance (template per MHA’s requirements). He/She shall be able to upload documents (pdf, word, excel, etc) when submitting for security clearance. Upon clicking on ‘Submit’ for submission of security clearance, system shall route the request to MHA Office for processing. An email notification shall be sent to the MHA Officer to inform of a request pending his/her action. System shall send an email notification to CRO(Undertaking) after MHA Office updates in CRIPS the outcome of the security clearance. If it is successful, an email notification shall be sent to Controller Undertakings to inform him/her to approve the undertakings requirements. If it is unsuccessful, an email notification shall be sent to the relevant Lead Agency and CRO(Undertaking). If the case requires CRO(Undertaking)’s follow-up, he/she shall be able to update the information and re-submit the case to MHA Office for security clearance. If the case requires Lead Agency’s follow-up, he/she shall be able to reallocate the request to another company and CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to submit the request for security clearance after updating the relevant information. Upon successfully clearance by MHA Office, the request shall be routed to Controller Undertakings for his/her approval. Of note, MHA Office may indicate an expiry date for the security clearance. a. If MHA Office indicate the expiry date as “31-12-9999”, it means no expiry date. b. For other dates, CRO(Undertaking) shall initiate security re-clearance at least 2 months before the security clearance expiry date. c. System shall have a workflow to allow CRO(Undertaking) to submit for security re-clearance. The re-clearance requests could be due to changes in the firm’s senior management or expiry set by MHA Office. d. Expiry and security re-clearance shall not reset the processes performed upon MHA Office’s first security clearance. Controller Undertakings shall be able to select a coordinating agency (optional) for firms that would be supporting more than one agency. Upon Controller Undertakings’ approval, system shall assign if the firm is an ‘individual firm’ or ‘shared-firm’. For ‘shared-firm’, system shall send notifications automatically to all relevant CRO(Undertaking). This ‘individual firm’ or ‘shared-firm’ indicator shall be refreshed automatically and be visible at all time when CRO(Undertaking) displays the firm’s information.

user_stories.title: 8.2 Manage Firms Information
user_stories.verifiable:
System shall have flexibility such that CRO(Undertaking) can manage the firm’s information without having to de-register and re-register the firm.
For undertakings registered by my agency, system shall allow CRO(Undertaking) to edit and view information of the company, e.g. a. The company’s Point of Contact b. Internal comments (any notes about the company)
For allocated or approved firms, CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to update selected information, e.g. addresses, contact details, etc.
When displaying the firm’s name on screen or in generated reports, system shall use the firm’s UEN to retrieve the most updated company name based on ACRA data that is also stored in CRIPS. SSIC of the company shall also be displayed.
For undertakings registered by an agency, system shall allow the CRO(Undertaking) of that particular agency to de-register companies that have been allocated by Lead Agency or have been approved by Controller Undertakings. An email notification shall be sent to Controller Undertakings to inform of the de-registration request pending his/her action.
The system shall send an email notification to CRO(Undertaking) to inform him/her that Controller Undertakings has deallocated the firm.
CRO(Undertaking) shall be able to re-submit security clearance should the approved EF has senior management changes. The re-submission shall be routed to MHA Office for processing, including an email notification to inform MHA Office that there are re-submission requests and require their actions.

user_stories.title: 19.3 Acceptable Use Policy
user_stories.verifiable: On first login, new users shall be prompted the terms and conditions for the use of CRIPS. He/She must review all the terms and conditions before he/she can acknowledge that he/she agree to abide by them. Only upon acknowledging the AUP, he/she can access the CRIPS modules and functions available for him/her. On an annual basis (to use 1st Jan of each year), all existing users shall be prompted to acknowledge the AUP again. Only upon acknowledging the AUP, he/she can access the CRIPS modules and functions available for him/her. System shall allow changes to the terms and conditions listed in the AUP. The updates shall be implemented easily, e.g. updates by Administrator or Service Requests. 20. ACCOUNT REVIEWER USER STORY

user_stories.title: 20.1 Review Accounts
user_stories.verifiable: System shall generate a task at the start of each month and set the due date for completion to be end of the same month. System shall allow changes in review frequency so as to adhere to the latest policy, e.g. changing review frequency, e.g. from monthly to 3-monthly. System shall allow such changes to be implemented easily, e.g. via changes to site properties. System shall generate an email to inform Account Reviewer of a task pending his/her action. System shall categorise the user accounts into “Active Accounts”, “Suspended Accounts” and “Removed Accounts”. When reviewing, system shall display all accounts including the Reviewer’s account. Account Reviewer must not be allowed to review his/her own account. However, his/her account must still be reviewed, i.e. by another Account Reviewer. a. “Active Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, roles assigned, last login date. b. c. “Suspended Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include the userID, full name, appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, roles assigned, last login date, account suspended date, remarks. Remarks should indicate why the account was suspended, e.g. due to inactivity for more than 90 days. “Removed Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, appointment, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, roles assigned, last login date, account removal date, remarks. Remarks should indicate why the account was deleted, e.g. due to inactivity for more than 180 days; change in unit. Account Reviewer shall be able to click into the account and the system shall display the detailed information of the user (i.e. full name, appointment, department, email addresses, remarks, role assignment, ReqCen assignment, etc). In each tab, by default, system shall list all accounts pending review, i.e. “Pending Verification” list. Upon Account Reviewer selection of the users by clicking on the respective checkbox, it shall allow Account Reviewer to choose "Verify" or "Remove" of the selected records. Upon choosing “Verify", the verified account shall be listed on "Verified" list. Upon choosing "Remove", the removed account shall be listed on "Removed" list. A "Select All" button shall be included in each page so that Account Reviewer can apply "Verify" or "Remove" to all the selected records. Account Reviewer shall only be allowed to complete the task when all the accounts listed in the task are reviewed. When the Account Review module is launched, system shall display a summary of all account review tasks and also shows basic information of each task, e.g. review status (e.g. open, completed), task start date, task due date, completed on, completed by. When reviewer clicks on each task, it should display information of all accounts included in the task. Within each task, system shall provide an option for Account Reviewer to export all the records within the task. The overall layout of the summary shall be similar to that for log review module.

user_stories.title: 20.2 Monthly User Account Review
user_stories.verifiable:
System shall send user an email notification to inform users to review his/her account. The contents in the email shall state the deadline to complete the review, typically within 21 calendar days. The duration shall be easily configurable using site properties or other suitable means.
Informed users shall login to CRIPS to confirm if he/she still requires the user account in his/her current appointment. If he/she clicks ‘Yes’, the account shall be maintained as active. If he/she clicks ‘No’, system shall delete the account immediately.
System shall send a reminder via email notification to inform users to review his/her account if he/she has not done so after 14 calendar days. The duration shall be easily configurable using site properties or other suitable means. The contents in the email shall remind him/her of the required actions and also state the deadline to complete the review.
System shall suspend the user of his/her account if he/she does not do review his/her account by the stipulated deadline. He/She will receive an email to inform his/her has been suspended as the review was not done. Administrator shall be able to toggle the account from ‘Suspended’ to ‘Active’.

user_stories.title: 20.3 De-provision user accounts
user_stories.verifiable: For users who did not complete the required account review by the stipulated deadline, system shall suspend his/her account and send him/her an email notification to inform the account is suspended as review was not done. For user who is a MINDEF/SAF personnel, system shall check the records in EIMS/EAD to verify his/her term of services or employment status. If he/she is no longer working in MINDEF/SAF, the user account shall be deleted automatically and immediately. Upon expiry of CR requisition plans raised by ReqCens, system shall delete their EMA accounts automatically on the following day. 21. LOG REVIEWER USER STORY

user_stories.title: 21.1 Review Logs
user_stories.verifiable:
System shall generate a task at the start of each week and set the due date for completion to be within 7 working days. System shall allow changes in review frequency or completion timeline so as to adhere to the latest policy, e.g. changing completion timeline, e.g. from 7 working days to 14 calendar days. System shall allow such changes to be implemented easily, e.g. via changes to site properties.
System shall generate an email to inform Log Reviewer of a task pending his/her action.
System shall categorise the logs into “Compensation Rates”, “User Accounts”, “Failed Login” and “Failed Validation”. When reviewing, system shall display all logs including the Reviewer’s logs. Log Reviewer must not be allowed to review his/her own logs. However, his/her logs must still be reviewed, i.e. by another Log Reviewer. a. 21.1.4 “Compensation Rates” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include CR Category, CR Type, rate type (e.g. hourly with undertakings), old value, new value, modified by, modified on (date and time). b. “User Accounts” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include the userID, full name, Ministry/Agency/Unit, role, action (add/remove), modified by, modified on (date and time). c. “Failed Login” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, appointment, Ministry/Agency/Unit, message, log created on (date and time). Message shall indicate why the log was recorded, e.g. invalid user. d. “Failed Validation” tab. Fields to be displayed shall include userID, full name, Unit/Department, Ministry/Agency, screen, message, modified on (date and time). Screen field shall indicate where the validation failed, e.g. Service Acceptance Details. Message field shall indicate what is the failed validation, e.g. accepted quantity cannot exceed the available limit. In each tab, by default, system shall list all logs pending review, i.e. “Pending Verification” list. Upon Log Reviewer selection of the logs by clicking on the respective checkbox, it shall allow Log Reviewer to choose "Verify" of the selected records. Upon choosing “Verify", the verified logs shall be listed on "Verified" list. A "Select All" button shall be included in each page so that Log Reviewer can apply "Verify" to all the selected records. Log Reviewer shall only be allowed to complete the task when all the logs listed in the task are reviewed. When the Log Review module is launched, system shall display a summary of all log review tasks and also show basic information of each task, e.g. review status (e.g. open, completed), task start date, task due date, completed on, completed by. When reviewer clicks on each task, it should display information of all logs included in the task. Within each task, system shall provide an option for Log Reviewer to export all the records within the task. The overall layout of the summary shall be similar to that for account review module. 22. LEARNING AND SHARING USER STORY

user_stories.title: 22.1 Learning and Sharing
user_stories.verifiable:
Chief Controller Office, Controllers, CROs and Administrators shall be allowed to upload files. After he/she has attached the file and upon clicking on the ‘Save’ button, system shall require him/her to acknowledge: a. The document classification is ‘Restricted’ or below.
b. He/She has scanned the file(s) and it does not contain any malware. Chief Controller Office, Controllers, CROs and Administrators shall be allowed to housekeep the documents (e.g. delete outdated materials) in the Learning and Sharing module. System shall show the date/time the documents are published in the Learning and Sharing module. Users shall be able to download the documents available in the Learning and Sharing module. Users shall be able to search using keywords. The search shall also be able to search keywords within documents available in the Learning and Sharing module. System shall capture documents that have been added and deleted and this information shall be available in history list.
